sources.summary: Across different climates and building cultures, many contemporary projects are working with local ways of building in new ways. Earth walls, bamboo structures , shaded thresholds , and collective construction processes are being reconsidered not as references, but as tools for the conditions architecture is facing now and will continue to face.
